items.title: Mississippi elects Democrat Scott Colom as state's first Black US senator since Reconstruction
The AP calls it. Mississippi will have its first Black US senator since Reconstruction.

brief: Thursday, November 12's snapshot has a throughline — Jensen Huang announced resignation or removal by November 11, 2026?, which turned up on hackernews, polymarket, wikipedia at once. Grand Theft Auto VI: Pre-Load Now made a quieter run across steam and youtube. Builders spent the day on meta/astryx. On Steam, Counter-Strike 2 drew the biggest crowd.
